name: agent-pr-guard
description: Agent PR Guard: a deterministic, warn-only check that flags when an agent weakens the tests, gates or config that judge its work.

plugins.name: agent-pr-guard
plugins.description: Warns when the agent's changes weaken the tests, gates or config that judge its work, when it stops. Warn-only by default; set AGENT_PR_GUARD_BLOCK=1 to make the Stop hook ask the agent to undo them.
